description.zh: 把「重要」定义成随机冲浪者长期停留的概率：可以模拟，也可以用幂迭代算出；阻尼系数和一条新链接怎样改变排名。8 页玩具网络。
description.en: Define “important” as the long-run probability of a random surfer: it can be simulated or computed by power iteration; how the damping factor and one new link change the ranking. An 8-page toy network.

label.en: power iteration for the dominant eigenvector

reason.zh: PageRank 就是转移矩阵（含瞬移）的稳态向量，用反复乘矩阵的幂迭代即可得到，和特征向量页的幂迭代是同一个算法。
reason.en: PageRank is the stationary vector of the transition matrix (with teleporting), obtained by repeated multiplication, which is the same algorithm as power iteration on the eigenvector page.

label.en: long-run frequency of a random walk

reason.zh: 随机冲浪者每一步按概率选下一页，长期访问频率收敛到一个分布，这个分布就是 PageRank。
reason.en: A random surfer picks the next page by probability at each step, and the long-run visit frequencies converge to a distribution: the PageRank.

title.en: Is a page important just because it is linked to?
